headline: 泰德拉索第四季回歸
context: 《泰德拉索》（Ted Lasso）睽違許久推出第四季，故事回到堪薩斯市，被形容是電視圈最溫馨的足球喜劇強勢回歸。同一天還有幾部新作上線。殭屍喜劇《Queens of the Dead》把背景搬到LGBTQ+倉庫派對場景，笑鬧中帶點血漿趣味。《汪汪隊立大功：恐龍大電影》讓小隊在史前動物島上展開救援任務。倫敦舞台劇《I'm Every Woman》改編靈魂天后洽卡．康（Chaka Khan）的故事，評論認為劇本浪費了她精彩的傳奇一生。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Tina Romero’s queer spin on the horror genre delivers plenty of laughs and splattery fun – even if the storytelling occasionally stumbles A zombie epidemic taking place in the LGBTQ+ warehouse party scene is the fun premise of this wobbly but often endearing comedy-horror. The film’s biggest ace is its cast, with charismatic screen presences such as Katy M O’Brian ( Love Lies Bleeding ) and Cheyenne Jackson (30 Rock) sparking off larger-than-life comedy types including Nina West (RuPaul’s Drag Race) and Jaquel Spivey ( 2024’s Mean Girls ). Slay, queen, boots the house down, etc. Meanwhile, director Tina Romero has some large boots to fill: she’s the daughter of George A Romero , the man who more or less created the zombie movie as we know it. In some ways that’s unfortunate: it’s difficult to watch Queens of the Dead without thinking about the seminal 1968 classic Night of the Living Dead and its variable sequels and imitators. To its credit, QOTD realises that it would be futile to deny its House of Romero heritage; instead, the script calls attention to its venerable ancestor with that film’s most famous quote repurposed as a sassy catcall: “They’re coming to get you Barbara!” It’s a moment that works pretty well. sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: It looked like it was gone forever, but Jason Sudeikis’s hugely popular show returns with a premise that’s all twee nonsensicality. If you love messages of positivity and togetherness, you’ll be thrilled Having transported a flailing AFC Richmond to the upper echelons of the Premier League with his wholesome, folksy and highly simile-reliant management style, the finale of Ted Lasso’s third season saw our titular coach return to the US to spend more time with his son in Kansas. At the time (2023), the general impression was that we were waving goodbye for good. But could this intensely American protagonist really do the most British thing of all and bow out at the height of his sitcom’s popularity? Nope. Last year it was announced that its star and co-creator Jason Sudeikis had caved to market forces and was reprising his colossally popular alter ego. It was the logical thing to do: the 11-time Emmy-winning show was the most-watched streaming original of 2023. Not that logic features heavily in this fourth season. Before we discover how Ted has been lured back to south-west London, we find out what he’s been up to in the interim. Did he parlay his success into US soccer? Return triumphantly to college football? Sit back with his millions and rest on his laurels? Nope, nope and nope again. Instead, he’s working in his local supermarket, warmly greeting his customers by name, providing moral guidance to younger colleagues and generally radiating his trademark howdily-doodily energy. Why? Because he’s a good man without ego who loves to connect and make a positive difference in his community! This is Ted Lasso we’re talking about! Ted Lasso is on Apple TV Continue reading...
